summary: Renders a race-information overlay by repeatedly filling a 64-byte local buffer with a format helper and drawing it with UITextRenderWithScale. The lap-count line is drawn in yellow (16776960) at x = a1 + 215, y = 46 with scale 0.75. Two text rows on the left (x = a1 + 15, y = 10 and y = 90) are each rendered twice: a white pass (0xFFFFFF) followed by a yellow overlay pass (16776960). Returns the result of the final UITextRenderWithScale call.

operations.description: Call sub_49C670(v2, 64) to format lap-count text into the 64-byte local buffer.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1 + 215, 46, 16776960, 2, 0, 0.75, 1.0) to render the yellow lap-count line at the right offset with 0.75 scale.
Call sub_49BDE0(v2, 64) to format overlay color text field 1 into the buffer.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1 + 15, 10, 0xFFFFFF, 1, 2, 1.0, 1.0) to render the white foreground pass of the first left text row.
Call sub_49BE50(v2, 64) to format overlay color text field 2 into the buffer.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1 + 15, 10, 16776960, 0, 1, 1.0, 1.0) to render the yellow overlay pass of the first left text row.
Call sub_49C700(v2, 64) to format secondary text field 1 into the buffer.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1 + 15, 90, 0xFFFFFF, 1, 2, 1.0, 1.0) to render the white foreground pass of the second left text row.
Call sub_49C770(v2, 64) to format secondary text field 2 into the buffer.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1 + 15, 90, 16776960, 0, 1, 1.0, 1.0) to render the yellow overlay pass of the second row and return its result.
